acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, GEO for practice area pages can help attract clients from nearby suburbs or regions. While the primary optimization targets specific cities, search engines often understand the geographical relationships between areas. By ranking well for a major city, your pages may also appear in search results for adjacent communities, especially if your content addresses common legal concerns relevant to those areas. Additionally, incorporating mentions of surrounding towns or counties naturally within your content can broaden your local reach.
